title: Geometry - Lesson 1 Assessment: Units for Volume and Capacity
description: Match objects and containers to suitable cubic or liquid units.

questions.question: Which unit should you choose for the capacity of a drinking glass?
questions.explanation: A drinking glass holds liquid, and milliliters are suitable for smaller liquid amounts.

questions.question: Which unit should you choose for the volume of a large storage room?
questions.explanation: A storage room is a large 3D space, so cubic meters are suitable.

questions.question: Capacity describes how much liquid a container can hold.
questions.explanation: Capacity is the amount a container can hold, often measured in mL or L.

questions.question: A cubic centimeter is written as ______.
questions.explanation: A cubic centimeter is written cm³. Some typed answers use cm^3.

questions.question: Which choice correctly matches the object to a suitable unit?
options: Swimming pool capacity: L or kL
questions.explanation: A swimming pool holds a large amount of water, so L or kL is suitable.

questions.question: Why is cm² not suitable for measuring the volume of a box?
questions.correctAnswer: cm² measures flat area, while the volume of a box measures 3D space and should use cubic units such as cm³.
questions.explanation: Square units are for area. Cubic units are for volume.

questions.question: Which item is best matched with liters?
questions.explanation: A bucket holds liquid, so liters are suitable.

questions.question: A tiny medicine dropper is usually better measured in liters than milliliters.
questions.explanation: A tiny dropper holds a small amount of liquid, so milliliters are more suitable.

questions.question: Choose a suitable unit for the capacity of a fish tank and explain why.
questions.correctAnswer: Liters, because a fish tank holds water and capacity is usually measured with liquid units.
questions.explanation: A fish tank's liquid capacity is best described with liters. Its inside volume could also be described with cubic units if the question asks for 3D space.

questions.question: Choose a suitable unit for the volume of a stack of unit cubes and explain your choice.
questions.correctAnswer: Cubic units or cm³, because the stack is a 3D solid arrangement and volume uses cubic units.
questions.explanation: A stack of cubes takes up 3D space, so cubic units fit the measurement.
